latest_scientific_finding.summary: Frozen N2 passed all preregistered broad-world gates on two disjoint 500-race synthetic seeds. It beat the best legacy C0/C1/N1 comparator in W0, W1, W2, W3 and W4, and its equal-weight pooled KL was about 22-23% lower than the best single legacy model on both seeds. Earlier v7/v8 work also established that N2_ONLY dominates C0/N2 adaptive mixtures in the current learnable W0/W2 construction because N2 is itself better on both W0 and W2.
